requirements.name: 1 validity
requirements.detail: solids 1, shells 1, closed True, valid True, strict True, faces 6

requirements.name: 1 extent
requirements.detail: projected span (Y) 1000.000000 mm vs spec 1000.000 (diff -5.09e-11); volume 1514991.817 mm3 (cap adds 66113.542; OCCT default integration gives 1512648.034)

requirements.name: 2 locked outline
requirements.detail: max outline-to-cap distance in the cut (3D rim) deviation 5.74e-07 mm over 202 cut planes; outline-to-surface max 7.68e-11 mm; outermost point of each cut sits up to 0.0938 mm from the rim along the rising span direction (informational)

requirements.name: 3 joins G1
requirements.detail: 4 edges, 1596 samples: gap 2.93e-14 mm, angle 1.44e-07 deg; curvature mismatch 4.052e-07 /mm (cross-join normal curvature 3.940e-07 /mm); closest sample to an edge end 5.9e-08 mm, 160 samples near collapsed corners not judged

requirements.name: 4 section rule
requirements.detail: 48 cuts (0 failed to trace); thick zone min radius 0.111499 mm at x/c 0.972039 (8 of 24 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 0.07352 at x/c 0.99828204, t 0.05 mm (24 of 24 below 0.9); 32 of the failing cuts cross the lip more than 60 deg from square; bending reversals 48 on 36 cuts

requirements.name: 4b lip-normal radius (informational)
requirements.detail: radius across the lip, perpendicular to the locked outline, at each cut's lip point; thick zone min 0.4132 mm at x/c 0.972039 (0 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 1.037 at x/c 0.97559048 (0 below 0.9)

requirements.name: 5 whole-cap map
requirements.detail: worst point radius 0.41184 mm at x/c 0.972039, t 0.8 mm, margin 0.01184 mm; tightest 2.72986e-06 mm at x/c 1; points within 0.05 mm of collapsed corners not judged (grid reaches 3.7e-05 mm; worst there 1.6 mm, score 8.95)

requirements.name: 6 TE closure
requirements.detail: sharp point; right (+Y): closes True, 0.02 mm before TE: t 0.005827, section min R 7.403e-05, ratio 0.0254; principal R within 0.1 mm of the TE point min 5.809e-06; left (-Y): closes True, 0.02 mm before TE: t 0.005827, section min R 7.403e-05, ratio 0.0254; principal R within 0.1 mm of the TE point min 5.81e-06
